issue_list.fix: Provide a meaningful accessible name for the link using visible text, informative alt text, or an aria-label that describes the destination or purpose.

issue_list.description: The main product section starts with an <h3> ('Today's Picks') without any preceding <h1> or <h2> in the main content, creating an unclear heading hierarchy for screen reader users navigating by headings.
issue_list.html_snippet: Today's Picks
issue_list.fix: Use a logical heading structure in the main content, typically starting with an <h1> for the page title and <h2> for major sections.

issue_list.description: The homepage logo image uses generic alternative text ('Store logo'), which does not identify the brand shown.
issue_list.fix: Change the alt text to identify the brand, for example alt="Reply Shop" or alt="Reply".

issue_list.description: A banner/carousel area inside the main content uses <div role="banner">. The banner landmark is intended for site-oriented header content, not for promotional content within the page body.
issue_list.html_snippet: ...
issue_list.fix: Remove role="banner" from the in-page promotional container and use a more appropriate structure, such as a <section> with an accessible heading or aria-label if needed.

issue_list.description: The page language is Italian (lang="it"), but multiple visible English phrases are not marked as language changes, including 'Reply Login', 'Guest Login', 'Today's Picks', 'Checkout using your account', and 'Checkout as a new customer'.

...

Today's Picks

... Checkout using your account
issue_list.fix: Wrap phrases that are in English with lang="en", or localize them into Italian so the page language remains consistent.

issue_list.description: Some interactive controls in the cookie preferences panel are labeled with placeholder text such as 'checkbox label' and adjacent generic text 'label', which does not convey the purpose of each checkbox programmatically or visually.
issue_list.html_snippet: label
issue_list.fix: Replace placeholder label text with specific labels that describe each checkbox purpose, and ensure the visible label and programmatic label match the actual function.

issue_list.description: The page does not include a lang attribute on the root html element, so assistive technologies may not determine the correct language for pronunciation.
issue_list.html_snippet: <html style="--vh: 7.2px;">
issue_list.fix: Add a valid lang attribute to the root html element, for example <html lang="en">.

issue_list.description: No skip link or other clear bypass mechanism is present before the large repeated header/navigation block. Keyboard users may need to tab through extensive menu content on every page load before reaching the main webinar content.
issue_list.html_snippet: <body> ... <div id="header"> ... <nav> ... many menu items ... </nav> ... <div id="main">
issue_list.fix: Add a visible-on-focus 'Skip to main content' link at the start of the page and ensure the main content container is identified with a <main> landmark or an equivalent target id.

issue_list.description: The main content area is built primarily with generic div containers and does not include a semantic main landmark. This makes page structure and relationships less programmatically clear for assistive technology users.
issue_list.html_snippet: <div id="home-wrapcontent"><div><div id="main">
issue_list.fix: Wrap the primary page content in a <main> element, or add role="main" to the main content container, and keep supporting section structure semantic where possible.

issue_list.description: Multiple action links use generic text such as 'Read more' and 'Discover More' in repeating card or carousel content. When encountered out of visual context or in a links list, these link purposes may be unclear.
issue_list.html_snippet: Read more
issue_list.fix: Use more descriptive link text that includes the destination or subject, or provide an accessible name that includes the related card title.

issue_list.description: Several inputs and search fields rely on placeholder text only, empty labels, or otherwise lack persistent associated labels, including webinar filters and the cookie preference vendor search field.
issue_list.html_snippet: <input placeholder="Year and month"/><input placeholder="Search" type="text"/><label for="vendor-search-handler"></label><input id="vendor-search-handler" type="text"/>
issue_list.fix: Add visible, persistent labels for each input and associate them with the control using label, aria-labelledby, or aria-label where necessary.

issue_list.description: Several interactive checkboxes used with adjacent empty labels in webinar cards have no descriptive label text, so their purpose is not programmatically conveyed.
issue_list.html_snippet: <input id="label-bb0ecc3c-ed4d-4d16-9fb1-078a40b5bd1a" type="checkbox"/><label for="label-bb0ecc3c-ed4d-4d16-9fb1-078a40b5bd1a"></label>
issue_list.fix: Provide descriptive label text or another accessible name for each checkbox, or remove it from the accessibility tree if it is purely decorative.

issue_list.description: Several buttons in webinar card action lists have no visible text or accessible name, so screen reader users cannot determine their purpose.
issue_list.fix: Give each button a clear accessible name using visible text, aria-label, or aria-labelledby.
